contracts.components: All seven _function0; class0 absent; ItemObject.Create returns with no components. Prototype _durability defaults do not establish Durability.
contracts.death: PESkEntity.DispatchDeathEvent -> LootItemMgr.RequestCreateLootItem; old ItemDropPeEntity attachment is commented out.
contracts.lifetime: CheckItemRemove: non-Quest Item category expires only when GameTime.Timer.Second-dropTime >93600.
contracts.native_stackables: Existing C inventory requires instance_id=0 and durability=0 for stackables; separately owned world-drop identity must not be copied into bag cells.
contracts.persistence: LootItemData archives item instance identity, position and double dropTime independently of the originating monster; ItemMgr owns prototype/count.
contracts.pickup: LootItemMgr.Update strict squared root distance <16 and living player; AddItemToPlayer transfers a complete stack or retains it; successful stackable transfer destroys the world instance.
contracts.roll: System.Random.Next(22,35); five trials; fresh float-cast NextDouble per ordered entry; strict less-than; first success ends trial; ID0 gives nothing; merge duplicate IDs.
contracts.special_items: MonsterItemAdd consults active special-collection registrations. Supported quest targets are guarded; only medicine2531 is collect and its Type0/zero target/chance is not monster loot. Arbitrary side missions remain excluded.

limitations: No observed original random seed; native RNG is an explicit adapter preserving ordered decisions and saved outcomes.
No corpse window, corpse pose, mission-special drop activation or new enemy populations are authorized.
Prefab fields are source-derived; full glow, ballistic flight, particles and audio presentation are not established by this metadata.
Native pinned cohort/reload and bounded storage remain separate implementation policies; generate only from actual positive-to-zero deaths, never disappearance or saved quest credit.
